reserveReview.rationale: The current Pharos fixed input captured at 2026-07-15T12:13:08Z (live-reserves:v1:b665aae3ca6cbc5c1c46f95ba6a6aff5cbd93bc19020e86fff3259f4481467e9) reports one live Honey reserve row, USDe (Ethena), at exactly 100%. The prior Berachain block 23506303 review remains preserved here as historical evidence: registered vaults then reported 24.603167 USDC.e, 0.000391 BYUSD, 695.783951 USDt0, and 11,288,159.771823145610901027 USDe against 11,285,263.733856488020121526 HONEY outstanding. The reviewed classification follows the exact current live row rather than carrying those obsolete trace weights forward.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pharos evm-branch-balances live reserve capture, generation live-reserves:v1:b665aae3ca6cbc5c1c46f95ba6a6aff5cbd93bc19020e86fff3259f4481467e9
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All registered collateral vaults and their balances were resolved on-chain; governance can change the collateral set or designate external custodians after the reviewed block.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Each collateral has a dedicated vault, but governance may configure a vault to forward assets to an external custodian. The reviewed public documentation does not provide a block-specific list of any enabled external custodians.
